Hims & Hers Health Shareholder Alert: ClaimsFiler Reminds Investors With Losses In Excess Of $100,000 Of Lead Plaintiff Deadline In Class Action Lawsuit Against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. - HIMS

PR Newswire

NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 16, 2026

NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- - ClaimsFiler, a FREE shareholder information service, reminds investors that they have until November 2, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. ("Hims" or the "Company") (NYSE: HIMS), if they purchased or otherwise acquired the Company's securities between August 4, 2025 and July 29, 2026, inclusive (the "Class Period").  This action is pending in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California.

Get Help

Hims & Hers investors should visit us at https://claimsfiler.com/cases/nyse-hims-1/ or call toll-free (833) 538-3604.  Lawyers at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC are available to discuss your legal options.

About the Lawsuit

Hims & Hers Health and certain of its executives are charged with failing to disclose material information during the Class Period, violating federal securities laws. 

On July 29, 2026, during market hours, the Federal Trade Commission ("FTC") announced that it had filed a lawsuit against the Company "alleging that the telehealth provider shared consumers' sensitive health information about medical conditions with third-party advertising platforms despite claiming its services maintain consumers' privacy and deceives users about its billing and cancellation practices." The FTC further alleged that the Company fails to "clearly disclose that it charges consumers for prescriptions almost immediately after they submit an intake form, despite telling consumers that they will be able to consult with a medical provider to find a treatment that is 'right for them.'"

On this news, the price of Hims & Hers Health shares fell $4.32, or 14.73%, to close at $25.00 on July 29, 2026, on unusually heavy trading volume.

The case is Velanki v. Hims & Hers Health, Inc. et al., 26-cv-09313.

York Space Systems Shareholder Alert: ClaimsFiler Reminds Investors With Losses In Excess Of $100,000 Of Lead Plaintiff Deadline In Class Action Lawsuit Against York Space Systems, Inc. - YSS

PR Newswire

NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 16, 2026

NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ClaimsFiler, a FREE shareholder information service, reminds investors that they have until October 30, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit against York Space Systems, Inc. ("York Space Systems" or the "Company") (NYSE: YSS), if they purchased or otherwise acquired (a) York Space Systems common stock pursuant and/or traceable to the registration statement and prospectus (collectively, the "Registration Statement") issued in connection with the Company's January 2026 initial public offering ("IPO" or the "Offering"); and/or (b) securities between January 29, 2026 and May 11, 2026, inclusive (the "Class Period"). This action is pending in the United States District Court for the District of Colorado.

Get Help

York Space Systems investors should visit us at https://claimsfiler.com/cases/nyse-yss/ or call toll-free (833) 538-3604. Lawyers at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC are available to discuss your legal options.

About the Lawsuit

York Space Systems and certain of its executives are charged with failing to disclose material information during the Class Period, violating federal securities laws.

Specifically, the lawsuit alleges that Defendants failed to disclose to investors that: (i) the Company's onboard mission and payload software was not fully functional before satellites were launched; (ii) this ongoing trend presented a risk to the Company's contracts with the Pentagon's Space Development Agency ("SDA"), deceived the SDA with false advertising to win its contracts, cut corners, and delivered satellites whose mission-critical-software was not completed; and (iii) that, as a result of the foregoing, Defendants' positive statements about the Company's business, operations, and prospects, were materially misleading and/or lacked a reasonable basis.

The case is Ianelli v. York Space Systems, Inc. et al., 26-cv-04074.

data.title: Battery X Metals Highlights Participation at X Takeover 2026, an Electric Vehicle and Emerging Technology Event Held at Tesla's Gigafactory Texas, Providing Exposure to Industry Perspectives and Technology Developments

VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Battery X Metals Inc. (CSE:BATX)(OTCQB:BATXF)(FSE:5YW0, WKN:A41RJF) ("Battery X Metals" or the "Company") an energy transition resource exploration and technology company, announces that representatives of the Company attended X Takeover 2026 ("X Takeover"), an independently organized community event produced by TOSV, Inc., held on October 10, 2026, at Gigafactory Texas, a Tesla, Inc. ("Tesla") automotive manufacturing facility located in Austin, Texas.1

X Takeover is not an official Tesla event, and the provision of venue space does not imply sponsorship, partnership or endorsement by Tesla.4 Battery X Metals' attendance does not represent or imply any commercial agreement, partnership, endorsement or affiliation with Tesla or the event organizers, venue operator, speakers or other event participants.

X Takeover originated in 2021 as Tesla Takeover, a community gathering organized by TOSV, Inc., an independent nonprofit organization representing a community of Tesla owners and enthusiasts.2,3 The event subsequently evolved into X Takeover, expanding its focus to include electric vehicles, energy and emerging technologies. The event featured programming focused on electric mobility, energy, robotics, artificial intelligence and space technology, along with exhibitor showcases, panel discussions, demo drives, creator meetups and community experiences.4

The event featured presentations by automotive engineering expert Sandy Munro, Elon Musk, Franz von Holzhausen, and Eric Earley.4 These program references describe the event and do not indicate that Company representatives met with or held discussions with the named individuals.

Figure 1: Will Fan, President of Battery X Metals, at X Takeover 2026 in Austin, Texas

Battery X Metals attended X Takeover as part of its ongoing efforts to remain engaged with developments across the electric vehicle, battery technology and broader innovation sectors. During the event, Company representatives interacted with members of the electric mobility and technology communities, exchanging perspectives on industry trends, customer needs and potential applications relevant to the Company's battery lifecycle technology initiatives.

The Company is currently advancing its patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, an integrated hardware and software platform focused on addressing battery cell imbalance, improving remaining usable battery capacity and potentially extending the remaining useful lifespan of lithium-ion batteries.

"X Takeover brought together a diverse community of electric vehicle enthusiasts, technology participants and entrepreneurs focused on developments across electric mobility and emerging technologies," said Will Fan, President of Battery X Metals. "As we continue to advance our patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, participating in these events provides an opportunity to better understand market needs, exchange perspectives with industry participants and identify developments that may be relevant to our long-term objectives."

For additional information regarding X Takeover, please visit the event's official website: www.xtakeover.com.

1 Tesla, 2 XTakeover, 3 Basenore, 4 XTakeover

About Battery X Metals Inc.

Battery X Metals (CSE:BATX)(OTCQB:BATXF)(FSE:5YW0, WKN: A41RJF) is an energy transition resource exploration and technology company committed to advancing domestic battery and critical metal resource exploration and developing next-generation proprietary technologies. Taking a diversified, 360° approach to the battery metals industry, the Company focuses on exploration, extending the lifespan of lithium-ion batteries, and the recovery and recycling of battery materials. As global electric vehicle adoption continues to grow and demand for battery lifecycle solutions increases, the Company is advancing its patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, which recovered approximately 99% of capacity lost due to cell imbalance in a technology demonstration conducted in collaboration with the National Research Council of Canada (NRC), with the NRC validating the initial and final state of charge of the cells. data.title: Align Technology Wins Significant Patent Infringement Case Against Angelalign at Unified Patent Court
data.description:
Align Technology Wins Significant Patent Infringement Case Against Angelalign at Unified Patent Court

Align Technology, Inc. (“Align”) (Nasdaq: ALGN), a leading global medical device company that designs, manufactures, and sells the Invisalign® System of clear aligners, welcomes the decision of the Unified Patent Court (“UPC”) finding that aligner systems incorporating Angelalign’s Torque Ridges feature infringe Align’s European Patent EP 2 237 738 B1, which relates to Align’s Power Ridge® technology.

In August 2025, Align initiated patent infringement proceedings against several companies within the Angelalign Technology, Inc. corporate group (“Angel”) (Hong Kong Stock Exchange: 6699.HK) in multiple jurisdictions, including before the UPC, which covers participating European Union member states.

On October 16, 2026, the Paris Local Division of the UPC ruled that aligner systems incorporating Angel’s Torque Ridges feature infringe Align’s patent. The Court rejected Angel’s challenges to the validity of the patent, issued an injunction requiring Angel to recall and destroy infringing products, ordered Angel to pay damages to Align, and granted Align other relief. Angel must cease offering infringing aligner systems incorporating Torque Ridges in Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Portugal, Slovenia, and Sweden. The decision is subject to appeal.

Commenting on the UPC decision, Arthur S. Hsieh, Align Technology vice president, Deputy General Counsel, Intellectual Property & Licensing, said, “The ruling represents a significant victory for Align and underscores the importance of protecting the innovations resulting from Align’s substantial and sustained investment in research and development. Angel has sought to downplay the impact of the ruling by emphasizing that Angel recently discontinued Torque Ridges in Europe and introduced a different feature called ‘Pressure Points.’ This should not obscure the significance of the Court’s decision: Angel’s Torque Ridges were found to infringe Align’s patented technology, and Angel has publicly stated that it will comply with the Court’s ruling, which requires Angel to recall and destroy infringing products, pay damages to Align, and take other remedial actions. Similarly, Angel’s characterization of Pressure Points as an “upgrade” or “next generation” of Torque Ridges should not be understood to establish that the two technologies are technically equivalent or that Pressure Points provide an equivalent alternative to Torque Ridges. Angel’s own public materials describe Pressure Points as based on the longstanding use of “hand-made dimples” to apply targeted forces to teeth. Align does not view Angel’s Pressure Points as a technological upgrade to, or an equivalent replacement for, the ridge-based technology at issue in the UPC proceeding.”

Align’s Power Ridge® technology is designed to apply targeted forces to improve root torque control and support predictable tooth movement. The Power Ridge feature remains available as an integral part of the Invisalign® System, providing doctors with differentiated technology to support high-quality patient care.

Align has not taken a public position on whether Angel’s Pressure Points implicate Align’s intellectual property rights. Align will continue to evaluate products and technologies offered by Angel and other market participants and will take appropriate action when necessary to protect its innovations and intellectual property.

The October 16 decision follows other recent developments in Align’s global patent enforcement actions against Angel. In February 2026, the UPC issued a preliminary injunction requiring Angel to cease infringement of Align’s patented ClinCheck® Live Update technology. That decision was subsequently upheld by the UPC Court of Appeal, and proceedings on the merits remain ongoing. In July 2026, the U.S. International Trade Commission (“ITC”) conducted an evidentiary hearing concerning five patents asserted by Align against Angel. Align expects an initial determination regarding the merits of its claims in November 2026. In August 2026, the Jinan Intermediate People's Court in China issued a first-instance judgment finding that Angel's use of its MasterForce biomechanical simulation system and ATreat digital orthodontic treatment design system to generate A7 and A7 Speed premolar extraction treatment solutions infringes Align's patent rights. The court further found that aligner products manufactured and sold using the accused technology also infringe. Angel has appealed the Jinan Court’s decision. Align continues to pursue additional patent infringement actions against Angel in China.

Align remains committed to advancing orthodontic treatment through differentiated technologies backed by decades of research, engineering, clinical experience, and investment, and to vigorously protecting the intellectual property underlying those innovations.

Align’s Cutting-Edge Global Operations

As a global leader in digital orthodontics and restorative dentistry with nearly 23.5 million Invisalign® patients treated worldwide, Align continues to transform the orthodontic industry through its global operations, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and doctor-directed treatment planning. Annually, Align invests over $300M in technology to give patients of all ages access to the smiles they want and deserve through Invisalign-trained doctors.

Align’s operations span the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions, with clinical treatment planning centers in Costa Rica, Poland, China (Chengdu), Spain, France, Germany, and Japan. The company’s global aligner manufacturing operations includes world-class facilities in Juarez, Mexico; Wroclaw, Poland; and Ziyang, China; Vienna, Austria; San Jose, CA; and a new aligner manufacturing facility coming online in 2027 in Hyderabad, India, together forming the backbone of the world’s largest 3D printing network for dental aligners (appliances).

Align’s investments in global operations are designed to bring its facilities closer to doctor-customers and their patients. In Mexico, the Juarez facility serves as a strategic node in Align’s global supply chain, enabling fast and cost-effective delivery of aligners to customers in the U.S., Canada, Latin America, and beyond. In China, the Chengdu treatment planning center and Ziyang manufacturing facility are central to Align’s long-term investment strategy for China, supporting the local economy and one of its fastest-growing markets by helping Chinese doctors provide millions of Chinese consumers access to high-quality orthodontic care. Wroclaw, Poland is the operations hub for Align’s EMEA business, bringing operations and support closer to the more than 63,000 Invisalign-trained doctors in the region.

About Align Technology, Inc.

Align Technology designs and manufactures the Invisalign® System, the most advanced clear aligner system in the world, iTero™ intraoral scanners and services, and exocad™ CAD/CAM software. These technology building blocks enable enhanced digital orthodontic and restorative workflows to improve patient outcomes and practice efficiencies for over 302.0 thousand doctor-customers and are key to accessing Align’s 600-million-consumer market opportunity worldwide. Over the past 29 years, Align has helped doctors treat approximately 23.5 million patients with the Invisalign System and is driving the evolution in digital dentistry through the Align™ Digital Platform, our integrated suite of unique, proprietary technologies and services delivered as a seamless, end-to-end solution for patients and consumers, orthodontists and GP dentists, and labs/partners. Visit www.aligntech.com for more information.

For additional information about the Invisalign system or to find an Invisalign doctor in your area, please visit www.invisalign.com. For additional information about the iTero digital scanning system, please visit www.itero.com. For additional information about exocad dental CAD/CAM offerings and a list of exocad reseller partners, please visit www.exocad.com.

data.title: Vanta Closes Second Tranche of Private Placement Financing and Welcomes Launch of First U.S.-Listed Peptide ETF, Highlighting Growing Recognition of Peptide Industry
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Vanta Holdings Inc. (CSE:VNTA)(OTC:VNTXF)(FSE:7BC, WKN:A4205J) ("Vanta" or the "Company"), a consumer health sciences and longevity company focused on preventative wellness and healthspan extension, and parent of the Vanta premium longevity brand, announces that, further to its news releases dated May 29, 2026, and August 21, 2026, the Company has closed, effective October 15, 2026, the second tranche (the "Second Tranche") of its previously announced non-brokered private placement (the "Private Placement"), through the issuance of 210,000 units of the Company (each, a "Unit") at a price of $1.00 per Unit, for aggregate gross proceeds of $210,000. Each Unit consists of one common share in the capital of the Company (each, a "Share") and one transferable common share purchase warrant (each, a "Warrant"). Each Warrant entitles the holder to acquire one additional Share (each, a "Warrant Share") at an exercise price of $1.25 per Warrant Share, exercisable until October 15, 2028.

The securities issued under the Private Placement will be subject to a statutory hold period expiring February 17, 2027. In connection with the closing of the Second Tranche, the Company paid aggregate cash finder's fees of $1,500 to registered dealers.

The net proceeds of the Private Placement are intended to be allocated towards the payment of outstanding and future payables and indebtedness, including amounts owing to related parties, and corporate awareness.

Together with the closing of the first tranche of the Private Placement, the Company has raised aggregate gross proceeds of C$334,579.42 through the issuance of an aggregate of 334,579 Units pursuant to the Private Placement. The Second Tranche constitutes the final tranche of the Private Placement.

This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy securities in the United States, nor shall there be any sale of the securities in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful. The securities being offered have not been, nor will they be, registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "1933 Act"), or under any U.S. state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements of the 1933 Act and applicable state securities laws.

Launch of First U.S.-Listed Peptide ETF

The Company welcomes the October 14, 2026 launch of the Nasdaq-listed REX Peptide ETF by REX Shares. Described by its sponsor as the first U.S.-listed pure-play peptide exchange-traded fund, the ETF provides diversified exposure to companies engaged in the development, manufacturing, delivery and commercialization of peptide-based products. It tracks the VettaFi Peptide Index, which comprised 36 constituents as of September 30, 2026.

Vanta believes the introduction of a dedicated peptide ETF reflects growing recognition of peptide-based innovation across a broad range of therapeutic, healthcare and consumer wellness applications. The Company is not affiliated with REX Shares or the REX Peptide ETF, and the ETF's launch does not imply any investment in, endorsement of, or commercial relationship with Vanta.

Vanta's Position in the Evolving Peptide Industry

Vanta has established a strategic operating framework and infrastructure relationships to support its planned U.S.-focused peptide platform. As disclosed in its news release dated May 28, 2026, the Company, through its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Vanta Amino Sciences Incorporated, entered into a master services, commercialization and strategic operations agreement with an arm's-length strategic operating partner.

The agreement establishes a framework for coordinating compounding pharmacy relationships, peptide manufacturing and fulfillment capabilities, compliant payment processing infrastructure, and telehealth-enabled commercialization support. Commercialization remains subject to adequate funding, compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, and the execution of definitive commercial agreements, as applicable.

The planned platform complements Vanta's existing nutraceutical and premium functional hydration portfolio and forms part of its broader consumer health sciences and longevity strategy.

About Vanta Holdings Inc.

Vanta Holdings Inc. (CSE:VNTA)(OTC:VNTXF)(FSE:7BC0, WKN:A4205J) is a consumer health sciences and longevity company advancing an integrated ecosystem of U.S.-focused peptide therapy, nutraceutical, and premium hydration products centered on preventative wellness and healthspan extension, positioning the Company to participate in the rapidly expanding longevity economy.

Vanta is advancing a U.S.-focused telehealth-enabled peptide therapy and longevity platform leveraging commercialization infrastructure and FDA-registered 503A and 503B compounding pharmacy relationships to pursue initiatives across recovery, metabolic wellness, performance optimization, and healthy aging categories.

Through its Vanta brand and select private-label partnerships, the Company develops, manufactures, and distributes premium hydration and longevity-oriented nutraceutical products, including, without limitation, its flagship proprietary Blackwater and BlackPowder product portfolio featuring bioactive compounds, trace mineral complexes, and patented Fulvic Isolation Technology™ designed to support hydration, mineral replenishment, cellular function, immune function, gut health, nutrient absorption, cognitive function, and broader everyday wellness-focused applications aligned with growing consumer demand for functional health optimization products. Vanta's vertically integrated operations include ownership of a natural alkaline spring water aquifer and a 40,000-square-foot, Health Canada and HACCP-certified manufacturing facility situated in the mountains of British Columbia.

data.title: National Press Club Statement on attack of Washington Post journalist in the West Bank
data.description:
National Press Club Statement on attack of Washington Post journalist in the West Bank

National Press Club Statement on attack of Washington Post journalist in the West Bank

PR Newswire

WASHINGTON, Oct. 16, 2026

WASHINGTON, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- National Press Club President Mark Schoeff Jr. released the following statement today:

"The National Press Club condemns the attack on Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine.

Levine was viciously assaulted while doing exactly what an independent reporter is supposed to do – bearing witness to events unfolding in the West Bank. We're glad to hear she is receiving the medical attention she needs.

Journalists should never be targets in areas of conflict or anywhere else. A free and independent press cannot function properly under the threat of violence.

The Israeli government must conduct a full investigation into the incident and hold those responsible accountable. A brazen attack like this cannot go unanswered. If it does, it could put other journalists at risk by encouraging additional violence against the media."

About The National Press Club

Founded in 1908, the National Press Club is the world's leading professional organization for journalists and a leading voice for press freedom in the U.S. and worldwide.

Contact: Dan Griffin, Communications Director of the National Press Club, dgriffin@press.org

Syncra and Neumetry Partner to Build AI-Powered Readiness Platform for Teenage Athletes and Their Coaches

Smart ring data meets FDA-cleared physiological AI to help coaches see which athletes are ready to compete, and which need rest

Syncra Labs Inc., maker of the Syncra smart ring, and Neumetry Medical, Inc., developer of an FDA-cleared predictive health platform, today announced a partnership to co-develop a readiness and recovery product for teenage athletes and the coaches who guide them. The product will combine continuous data from the Syncra ring with Neumetry's physiological waveform AI to give coaches a daily, evidence-based view of each athlete's readiness to train and compete.

Youth sports have adopted wearables quickly, but most tools were designed for adult consumers or elite professionals. Teenage athletes are still growing, sleep differently, and are more vulnerable to overtraining, yet coaches typically rely on how a player looks at practice to judge readiness. Syncra and Neumetry are building a product designed from the ground up for this population and the adults responsible for their development.

A Coach's Dashboard Built on Overnight Physiology

The first product from the partnership is a coach-facing readiness dashboard. The Syncra ring captures heart rate, heart rate variability, body temperature, sleep stages, and other physiological indicators around the clock. Neumetry's AI, which already analyzes physiological signals for insights into sleep, cardiac function, stress, and fatigue, will turn those overnight signals into a readiness score and recovery trend for each athlete.

For coaches, the dashboard is designed to:

  • Show, at a glance, which athletes arrive recovered on a given day and which are carrying fatigue
  • Flag early patterns associated with overtraining, illness, or inadequate sleep before they become injuries or missed games
  • Track recovery across a season so training load and competition schedules can be adjusted to the individual athlete
  • Give athletes an age-appropriate view of their own data, helping them build lifelong habits around sleep and recovery

The dashboard is a performance and wellness tool and is not intended to diagnose or treat any medical condition. Readiness is one input among many, and training and competition decisions remain with coaches, athletes, and their families.

Executive Perspectives

"Coaches of teenage athletes make readiness decisions every day with almost no objective information," said Ivana Pignatelli, CEO of Syncra Labs. "Our ring already collects the signal. Partnering with Neumetry lets us turn that signal into something a coach can act on before practice starts, built specifically for growing athletes rather than adapted from an adult product."

"Neumetry's platform was built to be device-agnostic and to find clinically meaningful patterns in continuous physiological data," said Paul Chen, Founder and CEO of Neumetry. "Syncra's ring gives us a high-quality, always-on signal from a population that has been underserved by wearables. Together we can help coaches protect young athletes while helping them perform."

Designed for Minors from Day One

Because the product serves athletes under 18, privacy and consent are core design requirements rather than add-ons. The companies have committed to:

  • Verifiable parent or guardian consent before any athlete's data is collected or shared with a coach
  • Coach access limited to readiness and recovery indicators, with raw physiological data visible only to the athlete and their family
  • Athlete and family control over what is shared, including the ability to pause sharing or withdraw at any time
  • Compliance with applicable youth data protection laws, including COPPA where it applies, and school and league data policies

About Syncra

Syncra Labs Inc. makes a smart ring that continuously tracks heart rate, body temperature, sleep, and other physiological indicators to help people understand their health and performance. Syncra is headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. Learn more at https://www.syncralabs.ai.

About Neumetry

Neumetry Medical, Inc. is a predictive health care company that uses remote monitoring and physiological waveform AI to deliver preventive, personalized care at scale. Its FDA-cleared SomnoMetry platform analyzes physiological signals for insights into sleep, cardiac function, stress, and fatigue, and its device-agnostic architecture integrates with existing wearables and medical devices. Neumetry is headquartered in San Jose, California. Learn more at www.neumetry.com.

data.title: EVIDENT Expands Its Pramana Digital Pathology Portfolio to Support Small and Medium-Sized Labs
data.description:
EVIDENT Expands Its Pramana Digital Pathology Portfolio to Support Small and Medium-Sized Labs

EVIDENT Expands Its Pramana Digital Pathology Portfolio to Support Small and Medium-Sized Labs

PR Newswire

NEEDHAM, Mass., Oct. 16, 2026

The new Pramana™ POD benchtop WSI scanner delivers autonomous imaging to help laboratories create pathologist-ready whole slide images with minimal operator intervention.

NEEDHAM, Mass., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Evident announced the Pramana™ POD whole slide imaging (WSI) scanner, a new benchtop system designed to help laboratories produce trusted images. Built for small and medium-sized laboratories and specialty applications within larger institutions, the scanner helps make digital pathology adoption more accessible.

As pathology laboratories expand digital workflows amid increasing case volumes and operational demands, they need scanning systems that produce consistent, high-quality images across specimen types while integrating into existing laboratory workflows. Evident designed the Pramana POD scanner to address those needs, extending proven Pramana autonomous WSI technology to smaller laboratories.

"Pramana WSI technology has received tremendous acceptance from pathology labs across academic medical centers and network labs across the United States," said Prasanth Perugupalli, Vice President of Digital Pathology, Evident. "By incorporating quality assurance into the whole slide imaging process, Pramana technology can help labs of varying sizes reduce the need for post-scan QA and the associated costs and delays."

The Pramana POD scanner automates imaging with an advanced tissue finder, extensive label detection, and automated focal plane and scan-profile selection. Built-in image-quality assessment helps deliver pathologist-ready whole slide images and identify scans that may require further review. Volumetric imaging captures multiple focal planes to support the selection of sharp focal information across the scanned area, with true 40X imaging at 25 slides per hour under defined conditions.

The Pramana series of autonomous WSI scanners is well-suited for most brightfield imaging applications, including histopathology, core biopsies, hematology, cytology, and microbiology.

"Scientific advances move quickly, but laboratory infrastructure changes slowly," Perugupalli added. "With the Pramana POD scanner, small and medium-sized labs can build as their needs evolve."

To learn more about the Pramana POD benchtop WSI scanner, visit evidentscientific.com/products/slide-scanners/pramana-pod.

About EVIDENT
For over 100 years as Olympus, we set the industry standard for optical precision in microscopy, helping the world see what was once out of view. Today, as Evident, we continue to help scientists, physicians, and engineers illuminate the unseen with advanced imaging solutions that combine renowned optics with cutting-edge digital innovation.

Our life science portfolio supports research, clinical diagnostics, and education, offering a comprehensive range of imaging methods from essential brightfield and darkfield microscopy to advanced fluorescence, 4D analysis, and digital pathology. In industrial microscopy, we deliver precision and flexibility through laser scanning, digital, and semiconductor microscopes designed for tasks ranging from routine inspection to intricate quality control and manufacturing analysis.

Whether advancing new therapies, ensuring product integrity, or exploring the unknown, Evident is defining a new era of discovery with easy-to-use tools that help unlock hidden answers and empower exciting new breakthroughs.

Evident is headquartered in Tokyo and supported by R&D and manufacturing centers in Japan, the United States, Germany, and China, with operations and dedicated sales and service centers around the world. For more information, visit EvidentScientific.com.

For Research Use Only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures. Future clinical availability is subject to applicable regulatory authorization, and regulatory status and availability may vary by country. Performance varies by specimen type and workflow.

data.title: Eylsia Nicolas's "What Will Become of Me" Reaches #1 on Groover Hip Hop Charts in the U.S.
data.description:
JUPITER, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Singer‑songwriter Eylsia Nicolas reached a new milestone this week as her latest release, What Will Become of Me, climbed to #1 on the Groover Hip Hop Charts in the United States and entered the Top 40 globally across all genres. The achievement comes just days after Nicolas was rushed for emergency medical treatment, a moment that prompted an outpouring of support from fans around the world.

Nicolas said the messages she received - numbering in the thousands - have been a source of strength.

"What will become of me will turn out fine," she said. "The love and support from people everywhere makes me feel incredibly fortunate. I've had medical reports in the past suggesting I shouldn't be singing, even with technological help, and I pushed my human side too hard. The part of my work that doesn't sleep or tire can put pressure on the part of me that does. But the future isn't a threat - it's only a challenge if we misuse it."

Despite the setback, Nicolas continues to write and release music, supported by a large backlog of unreleased songs. She remains committed to her personal goal of reaching one billion views in 2026 - a benchmark she describes as "not essential, but something I set for myself."

Looking ahead, Nicolas says next year will bring a wide range of creative projects, from music to film to stage productions.

"I've produced on Broadway before, and I expect the coming year to be one of major expansion," she said. "Some of the tools emerging now will surprise people - not in a dramatic way, but in how accessible they make creativity."

Nicolas also announced continued development of HHGC Studios (Human Hybrid Generated Characters), designed for talented individuals who face limitations due to age or injury. The initiative will work alongside her publishing company Bookkards.com, her record label, and her ongoing efforts to recruit young artists.

She emphasized that while she is grateful for the concern shown to her, she hopes attention will remain on those facing more serious circumstances.

"Please save your prayers for the millions of people who are truly struggling," she said. "I'm fortunate to have my fashion lines, the EDTV education network, companion‑AI care projects, and my cosmetic and clothing brands. I was always told health is the most important thing in life - and when you don't have it, it's comforting to have other things to hold onto."

Early Reviews

This Is Hip Hop HQ praised the track's emotional clarity:

"It balances relaxation with motivation. It calms the mind while encouraging belief in oneself. That combination gives the song an uplifting quality that helps listeners pause, reflect, and move forward with renewed determination. A solid 10/10."

Power Ace Radio highlighted the songwriting:

"The lyrics are beautifully crafted and easy to connect with. The chorus is memorable and invites listeners to join in after only a few plays."

LyricalOdyssey noted the song's thematic resonance:

"It deepens the artist's hybrid sound and ties her personal message to her broader musical direction. ‘What Will Become of Me' reminds us that reflection can strengthen our appreciation of life, even when the future feels uncertain."

data.title: AHF Commemorates 40 Years of Global Impact During Annual World AIDS Day Concert Celebration Featuring Ricky Martin
data.description:
AHF Commemorates 40 Years of Global Impact During Annual World AIDS Day Concert Celebration Featuring Ricky Martin

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF), the world’s largest, non-profit public health organization providing direct HIV/ADS services to over 3.3 million clients across the globe, will celebrate 40 years of impact during its annual World AIDS Day concert commemoration. Continuing his partnership with AHF, Ricky Martin will headline the free event scheduled for the evening of Monday, November 30, 2026, at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, California.

Martin – a multi-award-winning global star and philanthropist has used his platform to bring greater awareness and support for various issues around HIV/AIDS, human trafficking, and LGBTQIA+ rights. He joined AHF in 2023 to perform to a sold-out crowd as the headliner for the organization’s World AIDS Day concert at the Watsco Center at the University of Miami (UM) in Coral Gables, Florida.

AHF is returning to the Kia Forum to present this year’s commemoration and celebrate its 40th anniversary. AHF held its event at the iconic venue in 2021 when celebrating the organization’s 35th anniversary, which featured Christina Aguliera and Jennifer Hudson.

Commemorated annually on December 1st, World AIDS Day is an international observance held to raise awareness of the HIV/AIDS epidemic, show support for people living with HIV, and remember those who have died from AIDS-related illnesses. Since, 2016, AHF’s World AIDS Day commemoration, under the slogan of Keep the Promise, has been presented in cities across the country, including Dallas, Atlanta, New York, Washington, D.C. and Houston. To heighten broader public awareness to the on-going impact of the global epidemic, and the work still to be done, the organization has previously worked with acclaimed director/choreographer, Debbie Allen to produce the show and over the last decade, partnered with a diverse array of performing artists such as Mariah Carey, Common, Janet Jackson, Patti LaBelle, Jennifer Holliday, Diana Ross and Gladys Knight to perform at the annual event.

According to recent statistics from U.N. AIDS, there are over 41 million individuals living with HIV and 1.2 million have been newly diagnosed. Domestically, approximately 1.2 million people live with HIV in the U.S., and about 13% of them do not know they have it, according to HIV.gov.

Founded in 1987, AIDS Healthcare Foundation started as a network of hospices and grassroots advocacy in Los Angeles. It was originally known as the AIDS Hospice Foundation before changing its name to the AIDS Healthcare Foundation in 1990. To date, AHF has healthcare and wellness centers in 50 countries and 19 domestic locations including the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico. AHF provides direct HIV/AIDS services to over 3.2 million individuals in care.

The organization will announce other program participants, including local Los Angeles based non-profit organizations receiving funding support for HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment services. To learn more about AHF and the 2026 World AIDS Day event, visit ahf.org. To register for complimentary tickets go to: ahfwad.org

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF), the world’s largest HIV/AIDS healthcare organization, provides cutting-edge medicine and advocacy to more than 3.2 million individuals across 50 countries, including the U.S. and in Africa, Latin America/Caribbean, the Asia/Pacific Region, and Eastern Europe. In January 2025, AHF received the MLK, Jr. Social Justice Award, The King Center’s highest recognition for an organization leading work in the social justice arena. To learn more about AHF, visit us online at AIDShealth.org, find us on Facebook, and follow us on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok.

Located in Inglewood, California, the Kia Forum is the only arena-sized venue in the country dedicated to music and entertainment, delivering a superior experience for artists and fans alike. The iconic venue hosts a diverse range of premier events, featuring the biggest names in music and entertainment, award shows, combat sports, and more. Fans at the Kia Forum enjoy approximately 8,000 square feet of event-level hospitality offerings, including merchandise and food and beverage options. A tinted glass wall separates this concession area from the arena, ensuring fans do not miss a moment of the show. A 40,000-square-foot outdoor terrace wraps around the perimeter of the building and offers comfortable furnishings and food and beverage options from some of SoCal’s most celebrated brands. Designed with entertainers and performers in mind, Kia Forum Backstage includes star-caliber dressing rooms that provide unparalleled comfort. The Kia Forum received Pollstar's "Arena of the Decade" award in 2022 and was named the top West Coast arena in 2025 by Pollstar and Billboard magazines. thekiaforum.com | Instagram | Facebook | Twitter
